events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to a legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost one of the most electrifying performers of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: Album anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed the game. Still sounds incredible, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his tragic death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, music icon John Lennon was tragically killed in New York City at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary 'Starman' David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Celebrating Bowie
angles.copy: The iconic David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92

angles.name: Happy Birthday King
angles.copy: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page. What's your favourite riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Rod Stewart was born on this day in 1945.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame: 38 years since first induction

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 years on

angles.name: Remembering the legends
